title: Key transit routes
steps: Airport → hotel: bus 16 or 29 from Findel Airport to the city centre/central station, every 10–15 min, free. Journey is short (~10km); a taxi runs ≈15–20 min from the Kiss & Fly Parking C pickup zone if you'd rather not deal with luggage on a bus.

Getting around the old town: the upper town's sights (Bock Casemates, the museums, the Cathedral, the Corniche) are all within a 10–15 minute walk of each other — this trip's base doesn't need transit day to day.

Upper town ↔ Grund/valley floor: the free glass Pfaffenthal panoramic lift (Rue du Palais de Justice, 05:45–01:00 daily, closed for maintenance the first Monday of each month 09:00–05:45) drops you 71m from the Pescatore park down to Pfaffenthal in seconds — the practical shortcut back up after walking the valley.

Day trip to Vianden: take any CFL train on the northbound line from Luxembourg City to Ettelbrück, then connect to RGTR bus 181 (Ettelbrück – Vianden – Obereisenbach) at the adjacent bus station. Both legs are free nationwide transit. ⚠ The Ettelbrück bus hub was reorganized 10 May 2026 (new platforms, some stops moved) — confirm the current line 181 departure time via the mobiliteit.lu app or the Mobilitéitszentral (+352 2465 2465) the morning you go, rather than relying on an old schedule.

All public transport (bus, tram, 2nd-class rail) has been free nationwide since 1 March 2020 — the first country in the world to do this. Free fare ends at the border, so a cross-border trip needs a paid ticket; 1st-class rail also stays paid.
